skill: Bicycle Tube Puncture Localization & Cold-Vulcanizing Patch

knowledge_package.title: Pneumatic Tube Diagnosis & Chemical Vulcanization
knowledge_package.summary: Systematic observation, water immersion acoustic leak localization, abrasive butyl buffing, and chemical cold-vulcanization.

claims.statement: Submerge partially inflated tube in clean water vessel section by section while applying gentle stretch to identify micro-bubbles.
Sandpaper scuffing must abrade the glazed butyl mold-release layer in a circular zone larger than the patch to allow chemical solvent cross-linking.

rubric.title: Puncture Diagnostic Sequence & Patch Adhesion Rubric
rubric.description: Scoring of diagnostic leak localization, surface mechanical preparation, and cement drying window.

criteria.name: Systematic leak localization & tire rim correlation
criteria.description: Locates exact puncture puncture hole and checks corresponding tire casing position.
criteria.observable_indicator: Bubble emergence verified; tire casing inspected for embedded thorn or wire.

criteria.name: Abrasive surface preparation (mold release removal)
criteria.description: Buffs butyl rubber with emery paper to matte finish across 25mm diameter.
criteria.observable_indicator: Zero sheen/glaze on butyl surface; uniform matte black texture.

criteria.name: Solvent flash-off curing time window
criteria.description: Allows vulcanizing fluid to dry tacky (90–120s) before applying foil patch.
criteria.observable_indicator: Patch applied only after wet gloss evaporates to matte tackiness.

practice_task.title: Diagnose and Patch 700x28c Butyl Tube Puncture
practice_task.instructions: Identify puncture location via immersion, prepare surface with abrasive paper, apply vulcanizing fluid, and seal with 25mm cold-cure patch.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Bubble stream correctly identified at valve-adjacent sector.
Omitted emery sandpaper abrasion step completely. Shiny factory mold glaze intact.
Cement applied but patch pressed immediately at 15s (too wet, solvent trapped).

feedback.summary: Targeted corrective feedback for the next attempt.

items.what_was_observed: Omitted sanding of the butyl surface before applying fluid.
items.what_differed: Omitted sanding of the butyl surface before applying fluid.
items.corrective_advice: Vigorously buff a 30mm circle around the puncture with emery cloth until the gloss disappears.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Puncture pinpointed and marked with grease pencil.
Thorough circular abrasion achieved; zero mold release sheen visible.
Waited 105s until matte tacky film formed before patch application.

lineage.adaptation_notes: Diagnostic sequence reinforced via causal state decision tree.
